claims.claim: Anthropic announced and deployed Claude Opus 5.5, the flagship reasoning model in the Claude 5 family.
claims.notes: Official release statement from Anthropic product team.

claims.claim: Opus 5.5 features native Adaptive Thinking, delivering 30% faster token generation speeds on complex coding tasks.
claims.notes: Dynamic token budgeting allocates compute based on query difficulty.

claims.claim: The model features a standard 1,000,000 token context window with 40% reduced operating inference cost compared to prior generation Opus.
claims.notes: Maintains 99.2% needle-in-a-haystack retrieval across full 1M context.

claims.claim: Opus 5.5 achieved state-of-the-art results on SWE-bench Verified and competitive multi-turn agent benchmarks.
claims.notes: Sets top-tier mark on software engineering and long-horizon tool execution.

claims.claim: Claude Opus 5.5 is a software foundation model; it is not an embedded robotics controller or consumer operating system.
claims.notes: CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Clarify this is frontier reasoning API and software agent intelligence.

uncertainties: Extended 1M context pricing operates on tiered caching rates.
